predeclaration.predictedObservation: Visual ribbon station may show two lateral brightness transitions and stronger rail/interior contrast near candidate30 than same-heading +55px wooded control. Bright field control may itself give strong or paired responses due mowing texture; any such response is retained as a specificity counterexample. Training selection may tie or choose a different candidate; it is diagnostic only.
falsifiers: No finite positive two-edge fit at visual ribbon for all declared bank values, or weak/one-sided rail channels, falsifies the local visual paired-ribbon expectation.
Equal or stronger paired/combined channels on lateral or field controls falsify any claim that this local composition isolates the visual ribbon from these controls.
Byte mismatch, wrong original dimensions, changed PNG/hash, resizing, clipping required support, or altered geometry invalidates execution provenance.
unknowns: sampling uncertainty: nearest RGB sensor vs bilinear longitudinal average; no AA muting
predeclaration.analysisPolicy: Retain all candidate scores/nulls, profile counts and raw learner rows. No recentering, retuning, threshold invention, tuning after outputs, semantic acceptance, or classification. Source frame/crop equality is integrity evidence only.

releaseGate: No producer or recipe/learner/edge/sensor measurement until root next explicit packet; current declaration precedes all such measurements. Prior synthetic cases exposed, not repeated.
